newsitem.title: USA: Champion Financial to acquire Carlmont.
newsitem.headline: Champion Financial to acquire Carlmont.

text.p: Champion Financial Corp said Friday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire all the outstanding shares of Carlmont Capital Group.
Champion said in a statement it expects the Carlmont acquisition to add generously to 1997 profits.
Carlmont finances receivables for doctor groups, hospitals and health care providers.
"Following the closing of the Carlmont Capital and Consolidated Medical purchases, Champion will have completed this aggressive phase of acquisitions," said Chief Exexutive Officer Paul Caliendo.
